static_traits.name: Zhang Lei
static_traits.family_status: Has two children with his wife
static_traits.social_status: 与棒球联赛队友的关系因自我负面评价而紧张;拥有妻子与孩子的支持但not yet向其分享not足感
static_traits.medical_history: not yet出现类似心理问题;not yet接受心理治疗;without显著躯体疾病

basic_info.main_problem: 因为在自己最喜欢的爱好——休闲棒球——中表现not佳而感到'without用'和'not够好',这些想法导致without价值感与低自尊,并影响情绪与日常动机.
basic_info.core_demands: 这些感受对我的自尊与日常功能的影响not断加剧,因此希望通过咨询改善我对自我与棒球表现的看法,提升自尊与心情.'我愿意尝试任何能改善我对自己和棒球skill感受的方法'.
growth_experiences: 几年前加入休闲棒球联赛后,因一次比赛表现not佳(最初由一场糟糕的比赛trigger,中等强度压力),此后在每次参赛或想到棒球时反复聚焦失败,忽视进步,逐渐加重without价值感与低自尊;与队友关系因此紧张,情绪与日常Motivation affected;虽加练并向队友请教,但not足感not yet缓解;not yet向妻子与孩子分享这类感受.

special_situations.event: Making mistakes in recreational baseball league games (for example, being struck out last week)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在我最喜欢的爱好上表现not好,就说明我这个人not用
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加倍练习并向队友请教以证明自己,同时持续盯着错误not放

special_situations.event: After games or when thinking of baseball, focuses only on failures, ignoring good hits or defense
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only perfection counts as success;not完美就等于失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate积极反馈,轻描淡写好表现以自我鞭策
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那些好的瞬间not重要,我总是搞砸

special_situations.event: When in contact with teammates or preparing to interact with them, worries about being judged by them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果队友看到我的失误,他们就会看not起我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding teammates, reducing communication to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are all laughing at me

special_situations.event: 想到是否向妻子和孩子分享自己的not足感时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I speak these feelings aloud, I will become a burden to my family and be more disgraced

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted, to prove one's own worth (especially in the beloved baseball field)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评判,被羞辱与被negate为'not用的人'
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of being judged by avoiding exposure and intimate sharing
Maintains a sense of protection against loss of control and shame through self-devaluation and over-practicing

object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔的评判者(更优秀,可能看not起自己的队友)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor asks whether these feelings have been shared with the wife or suggests seeking support from family
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes expressing will burden the family and make oneself more embarrassed (equating sharing with troubling others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以委婉但坚定的语气拒绝分享,强调'do not麻烦他们',回避进一步探讨羞耻感.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing teammates' feedback or being invited to examine the evidence concretely
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把自我羞耻与not被接纳的感受投到队友身上,认为他们在看not起自己
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use猜测性语言(如'他们肯定觉得......'),语气not安,回避具体事实与正向反馈.

manifestations: 将自我价值过度绑定在棒球表现上;一次失败被体验为'我这个人not用';忽视爱好本身的乐趣与联结意义;羞耻使其not与家人分享内心困扰
outcomes: Interpersonal avoidance(与队友Relationship tension,与家人疏离分享)

manifestations: 说'我not该麻烦do not人',not向妻子和孩子分享not足感与情绪
Turns needed support inward, bearing it alone

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 认为队友会看not起自己,在看自己笑话
Attributing self-shame to teammates' assumed judgments

A teammate offers encouragement and positive feedback

Willing to try cognitive restructuring and behavioral experiments (clear motivation to seek help)

Recalling failure moments after the game

target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem,Low mood and decreased motivation;与队友Relationship tension
